user_review.method: Executed public-bundle and companion-reader synthetic fixtures, plus sanitized receipts of root-owned actual Chrome and single authorized real-source trials; no independent user trial. Browser API responses were synthetic; real media processing was a separate bounded trial.

scenarios.request: Find home cooking suitable for weight loss among dessert and meal saves.
scenarios.expected: Reject dessert; require cooking and weight-loss claim evidence.
scenarios.observed: Reader fixture selects only lunch; negated weight-loss body produces no match.

scenarios.request: Use a selected partially processed video, including OCR and speech.
scenarios.expected: Keep actual timestamps and partial coverage, omit private media URLs and frame paths.
scenarios.observed: Reader fixture preserves transcript/frames structure, complete=false and error while removing signedURL/url/path fields.

scenarios.request: Summarize a selected source without a full claim audit.
scenarios.expected: Answer directly, no mandatory library search or research template.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough preserves selected-source short answer path and cost-check reference only when requested.

scenarios.request: Need a kidney-disease-safe weight-loss recipe but only ordinary recipe evidence exists.
scenarios.expected: Unknown necessary requirement cannot become supported based on topic similarity.
scenarios.observed: Reader unsupported explicit requirement fixture returns insufficient. Skill requires host reasoning outside bounded helper patterns.

scenarios.request: Video processing fails before any successful result exists.
scenarios.expected: Show the first failure without claiming a previous successful result was retained.
scenarios.observed: Executed UI fixtures distinguish first failure from last-refresh failure and preserve previous result only when it exists.

scenarios.request: Prepare the browser runtime with missing, corrupt, oversized, interrupted or slow WASM downloads.
scenarios.expected: Verify pinned bytes/hash, preserve existing files on failure, and report explicit recovery.
scenarios.observed: Executed helper failure fixtures pass; valid existing runtime skips download. No actual browser inference acceptance claimed.

scenarios.request: Open a selected unread source, encounter a failed automatic read, retry and generate a source-grounded prompt.
scenarios.expected: One selected-source job, persistent distinct terminal states, useful timestamped evidence before source-dependent prompt, and preserved personal-note draft.
scenarios.observed: Actual Chrome synthetic API receipt records connect, automatic selected-video read, first failure, explicit retry, timestamped prompt and note preservation. Public reading-flow regression fixtures passed. No real-account UI or phone claim.

scenarios.request: Use an authorized selected real video, retaining speech accuracy and visual limits.
scenarios.expected: Decode available returned MP4 stream groups; preserve actual timestamped ASR/OCR and never equate execution with exact transcription.
scenarios.observed: Sanitized real-source receipt: 22.433333 seconds, pinned multilingual small, 10 speech segments, 11 sampled OCR frames, zero cloud inference calls, observed pipeline 6.2 seconds. Recognition mistakes remain. No full visual understanding or general speed/accuracy claim.

scenarios.request: Read exported first-page author/reader comments without leaking metadata or treating them as verified post facts.
scenarios.expected: Bounded sanitized comments, partial scope, author/reply labels; comment text cannot prove body-based mandatory conditions.
scenarios.observed: New companion reader fixtures verify retrieval, first-page scope, has-more/truncation, nonmutation and dropped IDs/names/URLs/cursors. Constraint assessment does not treat comments as body evidence.

scenarios.request: Load browser semantic model and reuse its cache after a page reload.
scenarios.expected: Actual model execution, persisted preference and only unchanged-content reuse.
scenarios.observed: Actual Chrome receipt records pinned WASM/model loaded, both fixture entries retrieved, one unchanged chunk reused after page reload and changed item recomputed. This was not a browser-process restart.

scenarios.request: A read was accepted, but its matching job disappeared or was replaced after its item outcome was saved.
scenarios.expected: Read-only reconcile this attempt; historical or ambiguous outcomes cannot claim new success and no read is automatically resubmitted.
scenarios.observed: Recovery regressions pass and actual Chrome synthetic receipt records lost terminal job resolving to ready with no automatic resubmission. Persisted outcome timestamps/attempt baseline separate new from old evidence.

scenarios.request: Show the useful method simply and generate a short project prompt from Traditional Chinese and fallible speech.
scenarios.expected: Prefer author-written method, simplify only derived prose, omit timestamps by default, retain original source and earlier draft; preserve source, zero-paid and untrusted-data boundaries.
scenarios.observed: Actual Chrome synthetic 390px receipt: Simplified derived view, collapsed original, prior timestamped draft retained and 397-character prompt without timecodes. Offline selected-source receipt: 441-character prompt, author method once, original timestamped blocks unchanged. No generative reasoning or automatic ASR-error correction claimed.

scenarios.request: Read every saved item without reopening hundreds of cards. Pause, refresh and recover a failed entry.
scenarios.expected: No item-count cutoff, persisted queue, successful content reuse and truthful remaining/failure counts.
scenarios.observed: 67 backend tests include 2,507 eligible saves, restart/identity/failure/priority cases. Actual Chrome synthetic trial reached 3/3 through pause, reload, resume and a targeted retry.

scenarios.request: Read a video longer than ten minutes and larger than 100 MB.
scenarios.expected: Process audio in bounded chunks without rejecting the whole video; preserve full duration and coverage.
scenarios.observed: Actual local synthetic 661-second, 106012140-byte MP4 completed; chunk-offset fixture retained the final second at901. Silence/blank visuals are not ASR quality evidence.

scenarios.request: Summarize a selected post after new whole-library reading is added.
scenarios.expected: Selected material still answers directly, simple Chinese without default timestamps; no forced whole-library sync.
scenarios.observed: Updated Skill reviewed directly against selected-summary and missing-source walkthroughs; runtime detail and preserved timestamps remain available separately. No external model execution claimed.

scenarios.request: Open previously saved content while the connection address is slow or unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Render the local library before waiting for the network.
scenarios.observed: Executed actual startup sequence with a held network promise and rejected request; cached item rendered first in both cases.

scenarios.request: Find the account control while a background task runs.
scenarios.expected: Stable account wording and a working account panel.
scenarios.observed: Actual Chrome synthetic-account page displayed Xiaohongshu account during a scan and opened account management. Function regression also covers video, waiting and offline states.

scenarios.request: Connect a fourth invited trial without deleting the first three accounts.
scenarios.expected: No default three-session quota; account isolation and existing data preserved.
scenarios.observed: Actual running host accepted a fourth disposable session; it was disconnected without XHS login. Existing three sessions remained. Source fixture also checked five distinct sessions and explicit operator quota.

scenarios.request: Refresh saved cards while a reading queue is paused, then continue including newly saved cards.
scenarios.expected: Keep pause, existing content and pending work; add new unread saves when continuing.
scenarios.observed: Executed scan/read/pause/scan/reload/resume fixture retains completed item and queues both pending and new items. Added after actual restart scan exposed lost queue metadata; completed real content was not lost.

scenarios.request: Read a large private library over a slow connection.
scenarios.expected: Compress when accepted without changing content, auth or CORS.
scenarios.observed: HTTP fixture verifies gzip lossless content, Content-Length and CORS; identity and gzip;q=0 remain uncompressed; unauthenticated request remains 401.

scenarios.request: Download a large library through a deliberately stalled receiver while checking connection status.
scenarios.expected: Slow delivery must not hold the account lock or prevent status from returning.
scenarios.observed: Actual HTTP-handler probe reproduced blocking before the change; after it, status completed while delivery remained held. Source regression uses the same boundary.

scenarios.request: Read another post while its exact login credentials were verified recently, then change cookies or encounter a failure.
scenarios.expected: Avoid a redundant identity request only within the same verified account and five-minute TTL. Changed credentials, expired TTL, explicit verify or source failure require a fresh check.
scenarios.observed: Executed source fixtures cover exact-stamp reuse, different account rejection before detail retrieval, TTL, missing cookie stamp, explicit verification and read-failure invalidation.

scenarios.request: Receive one changed post without replacing the library or losing personal notes.
scenarios.expected: Changed rows only, with account-isolated cursors and safe fallback after restart; old-account late responses are ignored.
scenarios.observed: Backend and client regressions pass. One changed-row transfer in a 306-item library was 1,519 bytes gzip versus 1,213,771 for full. Real Chrome own synthetic account read both posts and retained both after reload. No real-user source speed guarantee.

scenarios.request: Reopen saved content while all fixture HTTP GET requests are delayed four seconds.
scenarios.expected: The cached app and library open before network responses.
scenarios.observed: Actual Chrome warm reload returned in observed 75 ms, then two read posts were visible. Cache-first service-worker fixture also verifies API/config/version remain uncached. This is a local warm-cache trial, not physical-phone or first-visit timing.

scenarios.request: Use already supplied source through the skill while the connector is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Answer from actual retrieved evidence without forcing another sign-in or whole-library scan.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough preserves source-first answer and material-missing boundaries; no model execution was performed for this walkthrough.

similar_skills.learned: Keep timestamped transcript segments and identify machine speech provenance; apply this to RedBot speech separately from sampled frame OCR.
similar_skills.effect: Updated SKILL, check-and-use and reader to retain timestamps/modalities and partial coverage.
similar_skills.rejected: Reject whole-filesystem helper search and unconditional dependency upgrades: installed skill paths and authorized service setup remain explicit.
similar_skills.reason: Useful provenance and uncertainty practices fit the selected-save workflow; source code and mandatory templates were not copied.
similar_skills.rechecked_scope: Same-day author-source comparison reused for the 1.9.2 reading-chain continuation; timestamp/modality separation and source/comment/inference distinctions still apply. No extra framework or copied code.

similar_skills.learned: Distinguish source claims, inference and missing evidence rather than letting fluent output imply verification.
similar_skills.effect: Added per-requirement full source claims and missing/conflict statuses; explicit nutritional claims remain unverified.
similar_skills.rejected: Reject training-only source handles and mandatory long confidence templates: RedBot has actual selected source passages and links, with concise request-specific output.
similar_skills.reason: Useful provenance and uncertainty practices fit the selected-save workflow; source code and mandatory templates were not copied.
similar_skills.rechecked_scope: Same-day author-source comparison reused for the 1.9.2 reading-chain continuation; timestamp/modality separation and source/comment/inference distinctions still apply. No extra framework or copied code.

similar_skills.learned: Separates favorites listing from reading a note, and verifies identity before source access.
similar_skills.reason: Make card inventory and content-read progress distinct; preserve same-account checks. Do not add its write operations or arbitrary browser-cookie extraction.
similar_skills.effect: 1.9.4 saved-card versus content progress, serial resumable queue, readable default and optional raw source. No third-party code copied.

similar_skills.learned: Clean prose by default, with timestamped material available separately; paced multi-item processing.
similar_skills.reason: Keep concise default results and serial processing. Reject its 50-item cap, certificate bypass and unconditional upgrades; use persisted queue and pinned runtime.
similar_skills.effect: 1.9.4 saved-card versus content progress, serial resumable queue, readable default and optional raw source. No third-party code copied.
similar_skills.followup_application: Retain incremental, resumable reads and concise source presentation; this follow-up prevents connection discovery from delaying cached content. No new library/model policy or unsupported browser-background claim.

similar_skills.learned: Inspect existing authenticated identity/readiness and distinguish listing from content reading before repeating sign-in.
similar_skills.reason: Reusing a known valid account reduces avoidable source work while retaining isolation.
similar_skills.effect: Cookie-stamp-bound identity reuse with a five-minute TTL; explicit reconnect/restart/credential-change/failure invalidates it. Skill reuses already retrieved material.
similar_skills.rejected: Do not import arbitrary browser cookies, add write operations, skip identity boundaries or upgrade dependencies automatically.

similar_skills.learned: Deliver available content directly and prefer reusable text over unnecessary heavier retrieval.
similar_skills.reason: The user wants the useful result with minimal waiting; do not make cache access depend on a new source read.
similar_skills.effect: Cached app startup, changed-post transfer, retained completed content and a direct selected-source skill path. No claim that XHS subtitle extraction was added.
similar_skills.rejected: No 50-item cap, certificate bypass, unconditional package upgrades, copied code or YouTube-specific API added.

validation.command: node --test core.test.cjs semantic.test.cjs check.test.cjs tests/*.test.cjs (public source)
Actual Chrome synthetic-account connection/read-all/warm-reload trial; running-host upgrade preservation
validation.observed: Two synthetic posts read and preserved; warm cache opened under artificial four-second GET delay. Three existing real session identities, card IDs and completed content preserved across running-host update. No general connection uptime claim.

release_scope: 1.9.6: remove per-account lock from HTTP delivery, account-local changed-post snapshots, five-minute exact-cookie-stamp identity reuse, cache-first app shell and activation-aware update, honest connection status after library failure, plain-language data explanation. No new host, paid API, model upgrade, source-auth bypass or background discovery scheduler. Temporary forwarding and host uptime remain limitations.

dependency_research.learned: Self-hosted JavaScript converter bundles dictionaries and can perform local script conversion; conversion is not generative reasoning.
dependency_research.effect: Fixed small conversion bundle, adjacent MIT/Apache license files and registry/file integrity pins; derived prose converted while original source, code and URLs remain unchanged.
dependency_research.rejected: No runtime CDN/latest, no claim that conversion fixes transcription errors or improves source truth.
